app.tagline: See what your lab report is telling you.
app.disclaimer: Nabz explains results. It does not diagnose. Talk to your doctor about your results.
app.dev_banner: Development build: sign-in arrives in Sprint 6, so everyone uses one local account.

home.title: Your family
home.subtitle: Each person's reports stay separate.
home.empty_body: Start with yourself or the family member whose reports you look after.

profile_form.title: Add a person
profile_form.name: Name
profile_form.consent: I agree that Nabz may read and store this person's lab reports to explain them.
profile_form.consent_note: Consent can be withdrawn at any time.
profile_form.consent_needed: Consent is needed before reports can be read.

person.empty_body: A photo or PDF of a blood-test report works.

upload.title: Upload a report
upload.hint: Lay the report flat in good light. PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
upload.failed: Nabz couldn't read this report. Try a clearer photo or the PDF.
upload.drop: Drop the file here, or choose it.
upload.too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB. Try the PDF, or a smaller photo.

review.title: Check the values
review.intro: Nabz read these values from the report. Compare each one with the page and correct anything that's wrong. Nothing is explained until you confirm.
review.confirmed_body: Nabz has analysed them. The explanation arrives in the next update.
review.blocked: Every row needs a test and a number. Correct or remove the rows marked “Check this”.
review.not_editable: This report has been confirmed and can't be edited.
review.page_alt: Report page {{n}}, with the values Nabz read outlined

not_found.title: Nothing here
not_found.body: This page doesn't exist, or it belongs to someone else.

route_error.title: This page broke
route_error.body: Something went wrong while showing it. Reloading usually helps.

critical.title: Contact a doctor today
critical.body: Some results are far outside the usual range. Please contact a doctor today. If you feel very unwell, go to the nearest emergency department.

insights.title: Your results
insights.outside_one: {{count}} of {{total}} results is outside its range
insights.outside_other: {{count}} of {{total}} results are outside their range
insights.all_in_range: All {{total}} results are within their range
insights.explanation_pending: A plain-language explanation of these results will appear here.
insights.flag_disagrees: The report's printed H/L flag doesn't match this range.
insights.values_as_read: Values as read from the report

history.trend_rising: Rising by about {{slope}} a year over {{span}}.
history.trend_falling: Falling by about {{slope}} a year over {{span}}.
history.projection_leave_high: If this continues, it would reach the upper limit ({{value}}) around {{date}}.
history.projection_leave_low: If this continues, it would reach the lower limit ({{value}}) around {{date}}.
history.projection_enter_high: If this continues, it would come back under the upper limit ({{value}}) around {{date}}.
history.projection_enter_low: If this continues, it would come back above the lower limit ({{value}}) around {{date}}.
history.projection_note: This extends the past results forward. It isn't a prediction.
history.reason_too_few: Three results show a direction. A fourth will show whether it's a real trend.
history.reason_short_span: These results are too close together to judge a yearly trend.
history.reason_no_variation_data: Nabz doesn't judge trends for this test: there's no data on how much it normally varies.
history.reason_within_variation: The change so far is within this test's normal variation.
history.few_results_one: One result so far. Trends appear from three results.
history.few_results_other: {{count}} results so far. Trends appear from three results.
history.rcv: Between two results, a rise of more than {{up}} or a fall of more than {{down}} is unlikely to be normal variation.
history.percentile: The latest result is at about the {{p}} percentile of {{group}}.
history.percentile_below: The latest result is below the 5th percentile of {{group}}.
history.percentile_above: The latest result is above the 95th percentile of {{group}}.
history.percentile_note: {{population}}. A population comparison is context only; your lab's range is what counts.
history.chart_label: {{test}} over time, with the range from the latest report

explain.title: What this means
explain.none: The explanation hasn't been written in this language yet.
explain.source_note: Test information from MedlinePlus, US National Library of Medicine (public domain).
explain.disclaimer: This explanation helps you understand your results. It is not a diagnosis. Talk to your doctor about what they mean for you.
explain.template_note: This explanation is built from your values only.
explain.reason_no_consent: Nabz can write a fuller explanation with an AI service. It sends only your test values, age group and sex: no name, no dates, nothing else from your report.
explain.reason_validation: A fuller explanation was written, but it didn't pass Nabz's safety checks, so this safer one is shown.
explain.reason_provider_error: The AI service didn't respond, so this explanation is built from your values only.
explain.reason_critical: Because a result is beyond a critical limit, Nabz shows only this fixed explanation.
explain.voice_consent: Listening sends the explanation's text (no name or report details) to ElevenLabs to turn it into speech.
explain.audio_failed: The audio couldn't be made just now. Try again later.

privacy.title: Privacy choices
privacy.external_ai_note: Sends test values, age group and sex. Never your name or dates.
privacy.voice_note: Sends the explanation text to ElevenLabs to make audio.
